metadata.description: Universal Consent Layer, For Personal Data

resources.description: Notarize a document on Algorand: send its SHA-256 (the document never leaves you) and get back the unsigned 0-ALGO anchor transaction to sign. Verify later for free at GET /v1/attest/{txId}.
Compliance receipt for a Civitas consent request: canonical snapshot of the on-chain consent at the current round, its SHA-256, and an anchor transaction for the org or user to sign.
Check whether a Civitas consent request is live right now: status, expiry and the exact fields the user shared. No API key needed.

Proof that an Algorand address holds a Civitas identity of a given document type (Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID), pinned to a round. Reveals existence only, never document contents.
